movers.text: Starting PG Landen Joseph (26.5 mpg, ankle, hurt 11/20 vs Utah) did not play vs Northwestern on 11/22; Dayton lost 79-55. Malcolm Thomas (ankle) was also out.
Starter Neo Avdalas (24 mpg, team-high 3.8 apg) fractured his left wrist vs. Georgia and had surgery; UNC says he is out about two months (announced 11/17).
Northwestern lost F Ryan Soulis (11 mpg) for the season (foot surgery, hurt 11/13 vs DePaul); big man Luke McEldon is also out, leaving Okku Federiko and 7-3 Symon Ghai at center.

Tennessee.text: Tennessee's Jalen Haralson (20.5 mpg) sat out the 11/20 win over Coastal Carolina; the News Sentinel (11/21) says he may return next week. Status for the Maryland game unconfirmed.
